Recorded claim:
For remote message content, arm `BrowserTestUtils.waitForPopupEvent(contextMenu, "shown")`, synthesize `contextmenu` on `"body"` through `aboutMessage.getMessagePaneBrowser()`, then interact with menus. Repeating the file with `--repeat` can cause `NS_MSG_FOLDER_EXISTS`; use a fresh forced-install focused run instead. [Task 1]
